title: Exotic Spicy Ukrainian Pork Skewers
description: Tender and spicy Ukrainian pork skewers marinated in a mixture of seasoned rice vinegar and render fat, perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, render fat, garlic, ginger, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper
Add the pork pieces to the marinade and toss to coat
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the grill or grill pan with oil to prevent sticking
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork is cooked through
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving
